text: Can be controlled from scripts or the shell prompt to open windows, send text, and change titles
quote: kitty can be controlled from scripts or the shell prompt. You can open new windows, send arbitrary text input to any window, change the title of windows and tabs, etc.

text: Implements a terminal graphics protocol for rendering arbitrary pixel/raster graphics on screen
quote: Terminal graphics protocol: allows the program running in the terminal, hereafter called the client, to render arbitrary pixel (raster) graphics to the screen of the terminal emulator.

text: Shell integration with zsh/fish/bash adds prompt jumping, output paging, and mouse cursor editing
quote: Shell integration with zsh, fish and bash enables features such as jumping to previous prompts in the scrollback, viewing the output of the last command in less, using the mouse to move the cursor while editing prompts, etc.

text: SSH kitten sets up remote shell integration, file transfer, connection reuse, and socket forwarding
quote: The ssh kitten allows you to login easily to remote hosts, and automatically setup the environment there to be as comfortable as your local shell; automatic shell integration, file transfer and reuse of connections, plus automatic forwardin

text: Configuration is stored in a plain-text kitty.conf file
Windows can be arranged into tabs, splits, and multiple layouts
Supports changing and customizing color themes
Supports changing fonts including ligatures and fallback configuration
Includes a kitty-diff kitten for side-by-side file diffing
Provides a Unicode input tool for entering arbitrary Unicode characters
Hints kitten's matching and actions can be completely customized
quote: Completely customizing the matching and actions of the kitten

text: Hints kitten lets you select and act on URLs/paths/text from terminal output via keyboard
Supports wide-gamut color formats for richer color rendering
Provides git integration (e.g. as a diff pager)
Can automatically switch color themes when the OS toggles light/dark mode
quote: Change color themes automatically when the OS switches between light and dark

text: Documents the full set of mappable keyboard/action bindings for customization
Supports startup sessions and programmable tabs/splits/layouts to define a working environment
quote: Control it from scripts or the shell; Extend with kittens using the Python language; Use startup sessions to specify working environments; Programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts to manage windows.
